name: eurogovernance
description: Multi-Tenant B2B GRC SaaS on Firebase covering GDPR, EU AI Act, EU Data Act, ISO 27001, and ISO 42001

scripts.build: npm run build --workspaces --if-present && node scripts/sync-functions-shared-types.mjs --check && npm --prefix functions run build
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && npm --prefix functions run typecheck
scripts.test:ci: npm run typecheck && npm run security:lock && npm run security:audit && npm run security:web-bundle && npm run test:delivery-gates && npm run test:rules && npm run test:functions:integration
scripts.verify:production-candidate: EXPECTED_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID=eurogovernance-prod npm run emulators:exec && npm run release:gate
scripts.emulators:exec: npm run build && npm run security:functions-install && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,auth,storage,functions "npm run test:ci"
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run verify:staging-candidate && firebase deploy --project staging --only firestore:rules,firestore:indexes,storage,functions,hosting
scripts.deploy:production: npm run verify:production-candidate && firebase deploy --project production --only firestore:rules,firestore:indexes,storage,hosting && firebase deploy --project production --only functions
